title: Ops runbook + outcome tracking + maintenance rotation + annual fiscal-year refresh cadence
context: After the project ships to a real partner (task 018), it must be sustainably maintained. Budget and contract data is annual; each fiscal year requires a new snapshot, re-reconciliation, re-review, and the prior explainer to be bannered as superseded. The project needs a named maintenance rotation, an ops runbook, outcome tracking (partner use and comprehension instances, not page views), and a documented, expert-gated process for adding a second jurisdiction. Depends on handoff-018.
objective: Write the ops runbook and establish outcome tracking, maintenance rotation, and annual fiscal-year refresh cadence for Open-Spending-Explainers after M5 delivery.
acceptanceCriteria: Runbook covers deploy, source re-ingest, snapshot re-verification, and partner support procedures
Outcome tracking records partner/audience use, documented comprehension instances, and corrections issued — not page views — and is reported on a regular cadence
Named maintenance rotation documented with at least one named owner
Annual fiscal-year refresh cadence documented: new snapshot ingested, reconciled, re-reviewed (expert-gated, license-verified), and prior explainer auto-bannered as superseded with link to current
Documented, expert-gated, license-verified process for adding a second jurisdiction — only after the first is stable
output: An ops runbook document covering deploy, re-ingest, snapshot re-verification, partner support, outcome tracking, maintenance rotation, annual fiscal-year refresh cadence, and the gated process for adding a second jurisdiction — the M6 sustainability foundation.
